findings.text: The company was incorporated on 4 October 1971 and its status is recorded as active.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company.
Accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 31 December 2025 and the next accounts are due 30 June 2027.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 1 November 2025 and the next is due 15 November 2026.
The company has 10 current officers recorded, 9 of them directors, although only 100 of 120 officer records were fetched so some current officers may be missing.
One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1815, holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights and the right to appoint and remove directors.
92 charges are recorded as outstanding and 0 as part-satisfied, with 8 satisfied, out of 308 registered in total; only 100 of the 308 charges were fetched.
Since 24 October 2025, one director resignation has been filed (PERSON 421, 6 May 2026) and no registered office address changes have been filed.
The outstanding secured charges are flagged as a low-level red flag under the rules applied.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 475 is an active company with no insolvency record, accounts and confirmation statement not overdue, and 92 outstanding charges registered.
